defects: No manifold structure declared for M, N, P (missing TopologicalSpace/ChartedSpace/ModelWithCorners instances), so ContMDiffAt as used would not even typecheck

ContMDiffAt is invoked as `ContMDiffAt f Set.univ x n` with no ModelWithCorners arguments (I, I'); this does not match Mathlib's actual ContMDiffAt signature, which takes (I I' n f x) and has no exposed set argument (Set.univ is internal to ContMDiffWithinAt)

Composition direction is reversed: gold post-composes f with an immersion φ : N → N' (φ ∘ f, immersion on the codomain side), matching the informal statement's 'composition of f with an immersion'; produced instead pre-composes f with an immersion i : P → M into the domain (f ∘ i), a structurally different construction

Produced universally quantifies over all immersions i : P → M with i y = x inside the iff, rather than fixing a single given immersion φ at f x as in gold's hypothesis hφ; this changes the logical strength/content of the theorem (e.g. taking i = id_M trivializes the RHS in a way not present in gold)
Uses `Manifold.IsImmersion` (unpointed) instead of the pointed `IsImmersionAt ... (f x)` used in gold, dropping the localization of the immersion condition to the relevant point
n ranges over ℕ∞ in the produced statement versus ℕ∞ω (extended smoothness order) in gold, a possible narrowing of generality
